name: Northern India
note: Indo-Gangetic plains; summer monsoon deficit and pre-monsoon heat domes.

name: Western India
note: Maharashtra & Gujarat coastal/inland belt vulnerable to delayed monsoon onset.

name: Southeast India
note: Coromandel coast; enhanced rainfall during El Niño Northeast Monsoon (Oct-Dec).

name: Eastern India
note: Bengal basin and Odisha coast sensitive to reduced Bay of Bengal depressions.

name: South Asia Regional
note: Neighboring South Asian river basins including Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, and Pakistan.

name: Maritime Indonesia
note: Equatorial Pacific warm pool shift drives severe drought, peatland fire haze, and crop stress.

name: Philippines
note: Typhoon tracks steer into central Pacific; prolonged dry spells follow El Niño.

name: Indochina Peninsula
note: Lower Mekong & Chao Phraya basins experiencing reduced summer monsoon and dry-season heat.

name: Northern Australia
note: Suppressed tropical wet season and delayed monsoon onset during El Niño.

name: Eastern Australia
note: Murray-Darling agricultural heartland prone to severe droughts and bushfire seasons.

name: Western Australia
note: Modest drying anomalies modulated by southeastern Indian Ocean temperatures.

name: Papua & SW Pacific
note: Highland frost and severe water deficits during eastward migration of warm pool.

name: Peru & Ecuador Coast
note: Eastern Pacific warming chokes upwelling and unleashes episodic torrential rain and mudslides.

name: Amazon Basin & North Brazil
note: Suppressed convection over tropical rainforest triggering severe river low-flow extremes.

name: SE South America & Pampas
note: Enhanced subtropical jet stream drives surplus precipitation and crop flooding.

name: US Southwest & Mexico
note: Southern tier storm track deflection brings winter moisture and storm surges.

name: Greater Horn of Africa
note: Short Rains (Oct-Dec) amplified by western Indian Ocean teleconnections.

name: Southern Africa
note: Summer rainfall deficits resulting in widespread cereal crop failures and water rationing.

name: Global Continental Land
note: Baseline continental terrain without direct primary tropical ENSO forcing.
